summary: Elemental Royalty Corp filed a Form 6-K announcing the publication of its 2026 Royalty Asset Handbook, the launch of an updated corporate website, and its participation in a virtual non-deal roadshow. There are no terms involving any transaction, no stake, price, premium, or board recommendation. The filing is purely a routine investor relations update with no special situation mechanics, deal structure, or regulatory clock. No risk-arb angle exists as no acquisition, divestiture, or corporate action is proposed.
